scenes.setting: At Lawrence's grave: Dorian steps through a tree to prove what he is, takes Fors as his student (teacher and student only — no family secrets this time), and promises her the potion today
scenes.text_anchor: “Are you willing to be my student?”

scenes.setting: In the rented activity room, Dorian summons his contracted void creature Malmouth — a milky eyeless ball that loves lullabies and stores things in its belly — and brews the Apprentice potion on the spot, leaving Fors to swallow her second one and her lesson: honesty is the best policy
scenes.text_anchor: “Malmouth, give me the items that I deposited with you the day before yesterday.”

scenes.setting: East Borough, better rooms bought by Capim's charity fund: Daisy on her school lunch break carrying laundry, promising to teach Freja everything at night — then, leaving his Black Palm Street room in worker's clothes, Klein is stopped by a kindly old man: 'Sir, have you heard of the original Creator?'
scenes.text_anchor: “Sir, have you heard of the original Creator?”
